LESSON: SARUFI 11.4.1 MNYAMBULIKO WA VITENZI

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: KISWAHILI
Strand: Strand 11
Topic 11.4: Sarufi 11.4.1 Mnyambuliko wa Vitenzi

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo tutajifunza kuhusu Sarufi 11.4.1 Mnyambuliko wa Vitenzi. Soma, angalia mifano, fanya mazoezi, kisha jaribu jaribio la marekebisho.

SEHEMU 2: UTAPATA KUJUA NINI

Mwisho wa somo hili, utaweza:

1. kutambua kauli ya kutendeka kutendewa na kutendatenda katika vitenzi
2. kutumia vitenzi katika kauli ya kutendeka kutendewa na kutendatenda ipasavyo katika matini

SEHEMU 3: JIFUNZE HATUA KWA HATUA

1. kutambua kauli ya kutendeka kutendewa na kutendatenda katika vitenzi
   In simple words: practise until you can kutambua kauli ya kutendeka kutendewa na kutendatenda katika vitenzi. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. kutumia vitenzi katika kauli ya kutendeka kutendewa na kutendatenda ipasavyo katika matini
   In simple words: practise until you can kutumia vitenzi katika kauli ya kutendeka kutendewa na kutendatenda ipasavyo katika matini. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO

Example 1: Talk about Sarufi 11.4.1 Mnyambuliko wa Vitenzi using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SEHEMU 5: JARIBU HIVI

1. Underline two new ideas about Sarufi 11.4.1 Mnyambuliko wa Vitenzi in the examples.
2. Explain Sarufi 11.4.1 Mnyambuliko wa Vitenzi to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Sarufi 11.4.1 Mnyambuliko wa Vitenzi.
4. Show that you can: kutambua kauli ya kutendeka kutendewa na kutendatenda katika vitenzi

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA KUFANYA

1. Write five sentences about Sarufi 11.4.1 Mnyambuliko wa Vitenzi using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Sarufi 11.4.1 Mnyambuliko wa Vitenzi important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SEHEMU: KUMBUKA

1. kutambua kauli ya kutendeka kutendewa na kutendatenda katika vitenzi
2. kutumia vitenzi katika kauli ya kutendeka kutendewa na kutendatenda ipasavyo katika matini

Sasa fanya Jaribio la Marekebisho. Angalia Majibu baada tu ya kumaliza.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
